note: Issue #303: the dark master (src/systems/npc/dark_master_post.gd, src/systems/flow/dark_pact.gd). 'soldier': his soldier profile. 'cruiser.offset': where he waits in the cruiser's bay, from the dock pad (cruiser frame); he faces your ship. 'roof': the town marker he stands on while the Remnant hold the planet ('offset' from it), facing 'face'. 'meet_reach': how close you walk before his offer opens by itself; 'turns': his lines before the game asks Join / Refuse outright; 'end_delay': seconds after your answer ('join' / 'refuse') before the talk closes. 'standing': the Remnant standing you are raised to on 'join', and dropped to when you break the oath ('broken') or kill him while sworn ('killed'). 'friend_standing': at or above it (and the Remnant not hostile) you are their friend: in free play their ships are borrowed, not stolen (no alarm, no chase), each costing 'borrow_standing', and the desert droid posts sell at 'droid_discount' (the port's market does the same for friends of the locals); never under a droid's resale. 'blade': his sword fight (BladeFighter): 'reach' m, 'damage' a blow, 'cooldown_s' between blows, 'moves' (NativeMoves), 'deflect_chance' for a bolt from the front between blows, 'parry_chance' for a cut, 'blade_taken' (cuts that get through are multiplied by it), 'guard_cone_deg', 'stagger_s' when your block turns a blow, 'leap_min'/'leap_max'/'leap_cooldown_s'/'leap_s' for his bound (off the roof, or across the deck), 'climb' the height difference that means he must bound. 'drops': the item you take off him ('blade_taken' line). 'grip': the blade in his hand, in the rigged model's hand bone's space ('offset' m, 'rot' degrees; the blade runs up out of the fist). 'guard_pose': his arms while no blow plays (degrees): fist in front of the chest, blade up.

lines.brief: This is the moment you make your offer. The general is dead; you were waiting for whoever killed him. Tell the player there is a dark energy emerging, and say: 'Join me, and realize more power than you could know.' If they join, their first task is to clear the local guards from the barracks of {town}; the locals still think the player is on their side. When the player clearly says yes, use the join action; clearly no, use the refuse action. Do not end the talk any other way.
lines.brief_after: The player swore your oath. You stand watch over {town} for the Remnant.
lines.offer: There is a dark energy emerging. Join me, and realize more power than you could know.
lines.joined: Good. Your first task: clear the local guards from the barracks of {town}. They still think you are one of them. Let them think it.
lines.blade_taken: You take the dark master's red blade.
